key_concepts: The respiratory system enables breathing and gas exchange.
The respiratory system includes the nose, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, and lungs.
The diaphragm is a dome-shaped muscle that powers breathing.
Alveoli are tiny air sacs where oxygen and carbon dioxide are exchanged.
The circulatory system transports oxygen, nutrients, and hormones and removes waste gases.
The circulatory system is made up of the heart, blood, and blood vessels.
Arteries carry blood away from the heart while veins carry blood toward the heart.
